ablation.name: phase4i10b_ept_t01
ablation.notes: Phase 4I.10b: Endpoint Prediction Training (EPT). Structural breakthrough based on probe diagnostic. Probe found velocity field DEAD at t=0.5 (cos=0.01) due to FM midpoint ambiguity. ODE trajectory useless (reach_ratio=0.0009). EPT fixes this by training ONLY at t=[0, 0.1] — model focuses all capacity on endpoint prediction from near-pure content. At inference: num_steps=1, solver=euler (single forward pass). Theory: eliminate dead midpoint, concentrate learning where model is effective (t=0 cos=0.60). Combined with WCT alpha=0.5 for style refinement. Expected: clip>0.73, lpips<0.30 (both beat SaMam 0.7222, 0.3282).
